description:
Certified Safety Meets Premium Power - Engineered for peace of mind, the Rundeer Attack 11 is a certified electric bike, fully compliant with 2849 and 2271 standards—setting a new benchmark for e-bike safety. At its core is a 960Wh removable Samsung lithium battery with IP65 waterproof protection, providing long-lasting, high-capacity power. Lockable, fast-charging (5–6 hours), and built for endurance, this system delivers up to 68 miles per charge—perfect for both off-road explorers and urban commuters seeking a long-range electric bike.

1200W Peak BAFANG Motor with Dual Motor Option - The Attack 11 is powered by a BAFANG 1200W peak high-speed brushless gear motor, delivering 89.7Nm of torque for fast acceleration, hill-climbing, and heavy loads. For even more performance, an optional dual motor configuration (1500W peak) is available, providing added traction and torque for extreme terrain. Whether you're tackling steep dirt trails, gravel paths, or city streets, this off-road e-bike ensures a stable, responsive ride with consistent output.

Precision-Engineered Aluminum Frame - Built with an extended high-strength aluminum alloy frame, the Attack 11 offers enhanced stability, balance, and control. Its ergonomic geometry is optimized for rider comfort, while the durable structure withstands the rigors of aggressive terrain. Designed for riders who demand both comfort and strength, this moped-style electric bike is made to perform.

Advanced Full Suspension System - Equipped with a DNM USD-8FAT inverted air suspension fork, the Attack 11 delivers 160mm of front travel, paired with dual rear shocks for maximum impact absorption. The air-hydraulic system, 15mm thru-axle, and adjustable rebound/compression make this setup ideal for custom tuning. It’s a serious suspension platform for riders who go beyond the pavement.

Fat Tires & Hydraulic Brakes - Roll over anything with 20x4” puncture-resistant fat tires, perfect for sand, snow, mud, or pavement. Tektro 4-piston hydraulic disc brakes provide confident, consistent braking power in all conditions. A high-visibility 13W LED headlight, intuitive LED display, 5 pedal assist levels, and 7-speed drivetrain complete this high-performance package.

Easy Setup & Warranty - The Attack 11 electric bike arrives 90% pre-assembled and includes tools and instructions for quick setup. With an 12-month warranty, it’s backed by dependable support from Rundeer. Whether you’re commuting, hunting, or exploring the backcountry, the Attack 11 is your go-to fat tire electric bike for serious performance.

Rundeer Attack 11 Moped Style Electric Bike
